$description: Oryne design tokens: the one source of truth for every shared visual decision in the app. Swift is generated from this file (Scripts/design-tokens/generate.py); never edit the generated Swift by hand. Dimensions are in points (DTCG only knows px; read px as pt). Every token is one of three facets: form (space, radius, size, type), material (color, shadow) or motion. Components compose one of each; a variant changes one facet and leaves the other two alone.

primitive.$description: Raw values. Nothing in the app reads these; the roles below alias them so a change here moves every sibling together.

water.$description: The near-monochrome water, lit toward the upper centre.

white.$description: White at the opacities the app draws with (names are percent, 55 = 5.5%). Ink and surfaces are white over the water; brightness carries hierarchy.

form.$description: Facet one: where things sit and how big they are. Space, corners, sizes and type.

space.$description: One ladder on 4 pt, used by role. Things that belong together sit tight; groups sit far apart. The contrast between the two is the hierarchy.

hairline.$description: An optical nudge: a section label's lead-in over the gutter, a badge's vertical breath.

tight.$description: Inside a control: a segmented switch's padding around its parts, a tool group's end padding, a title's breath above its footer.

snug.$description: A title and its meta line inside a tile; a glyph and the words beside it in a meta line.

gap.$description: Buttons or chips in a row; a label above its field; a glyph beside a control's words.

item.$description: Tiles apart in a list or a grid; things apart inside a row (a picture and its words).

insetCompact.$description: Inside a compact card or a field: the link card, a text field, the composer's card.

inset.$description: Inside a tile, on every side; a floating capsule's end inset.

afterLabel.$description: From a section label down to its content.

controlInset.$description: A capsule button's horizontal inset, Primary and Secondary alike, the same as a tile's; a toast's leading inset.

block.$description: Blocks inside one section: a title block, a summary, a transcript; media above the meta line.

sheetTop.$description: A pull-up sheet's title under the sheet's edge: a section's air past the grabber.

gutterCompact.$description: The page margin on standard iPhones: the system's own layout margin, where a navigation bar puts its back button.

gutterWide.$description: The page margin on wide phones (414 pt and up) and iPad.

gutterBreakpoint.$description: Window width from which the wide gutter applies (measured 2026-10-22: 16 at 402 pt, 20 at 420 and 440).

radius.$description: Anything up to a control's height is a full capsule. Corners are continuous (superellipse).

card.$description: Tiles: anything you open (a card, a row, a current, a choice in a picker).

media.$description: A picture or a link card at the top of a page.

field.$description: A text field or editor you type into (a tile's quieter sibling).

thumbnail.$description: A picture inside a tile or a strip.

composer.$description: The open composer's card and the + panel: fixed, so a tall card keeps its text room instead of growing a capsule's round ends.

icon.$description: A site's icon in a meta line.

size.$description: Fixed sizes of things that are not controls.

metaIcon.$description: The kind glyph's slot and a site icon in a meta line.

glyphSlot.$description: A glyph's fixed slot beside a line of text (a source line, a sample question), so the words start on one edge; also the dark disc under a remove badge's ✕.

grabberWidth.$description: A sheet's grabber, the system's own proportions, drawn by OceanSheetHeader.

removeTarget.$description: The touch target of a remove badge in a picture's corner, and of the search field's clear.

thumbnail.$description: A row's trailing picture: a control's height, so it fits the row's two lines.

pictureTile.$description: A picture on a draft or in a strip: the composer's tiles, the edit sheet's pictures, a link card's thumbnail.

banner.$description: A card's full-bleed picture at the top.

hero.$description: The resurfacing thought's picture on Tide.

control.$description: Every control is 44 pt tall, the system's own. Floating bars are 56.

height.$description: A button, a field, a tool cell, the capture disc, a segmented switch.

toolCell.$description: One tool's cell in a group of several, as the system toolbar spaces them.

bar.$description: The capture bar and Ask's bar: a capsule whose end radius is half of this.

toast.$description: A toast: the bar's material, a step shorter than the bar.

discInset.$description: The disc's inset inside the bar on every side, so disc and capsule end are concentric.

type.$description: New York, Apple's serif, names what a page is about and wears the italic section labels. SF does everything else, on one scale. com.oryne.font.scale says how a role meets Dynamic Type: native (a system text style), metrics (a fixed size scaled by its text style's metrics), fixed (glyphs in controls).

pageTitle.$description: A tab's name, and the navigation bar's large title: the one place a page is named.

resurfacingTitle.$description: The one lit thing on Tide: today's resurfacing thought. Also an onboarding page's title.

subjectTitle.$description: A thought's title on its page, a current's name on its sheet, the question an answer replies to, a page's one-line empty state.

sectionLabel.$description: A section's label, italic: Resurfacing, Drifted in, Today, Nearby, a current's name in the Library's list.

statement.$description: Live words laid on the water while a whisper is caught.

wordmark.$description: The name Oryne in a bar, tracked a little so a short name holds the bar.

tileTitle.$description: A thought's title on a tile (card, row, current, link card, a choice in a picker): lighter than a heading so the tiles stay quiet.

body.$description: Running text in foam: a thought's words, an answer, a field's words, a line that opens a thought. lineHeight here is the extra leading between lines.

secondary.$description: Reading text a step below the words: a snippet, a summary, what lies beyond the Ocean, a count beside a label.

meta.$description: The meta line under a title, a domain, a provenance note, a status line.

note.$description: A quiet line under a field or a control: a notice, a hint, a caption in the composer.

eyebrow.$description: A label right above what it names: Summary, Transcript, Drawn from, a field's name in the edit sheet.

control.$description: A quiet control's words: Secondary buttons, the segmented switch, a toast's message.

controlStrong.$description: The main action's words: Primary buttons, Undo, a Link button.

glyph.$description: A symbol in a control: outline variant, regular weight, in a 44 pt cell. Fixed, like the system's own toolbar glyphs.

glyphStrong.$description: The send arrow and the main action's glyph.

glyphDisclosure.$description: A chevron in content: bare, the meta line's size.

glyphMeta.$description: The kind glyph leading a meta line.

glyphSmall.$description: A small ✕ inside a chip or a badge; a menu's chevron.

glyphLarge.$description: A symbol standing in for a picture: an empty link thumbnail, a widget's drop.

glyphHero.$description: The one glyph of an empty page.

material.$description: Facet two: what things are made of. Flat matte surfaces on near-black water, white ink at a few opacities, one soft shadow. Glass belongs to the floating layer only (bars, toast, page tools, sheet chrome, discs) and is the system's own Liquid Glass, not a token.

abyss.$description: The deepest water; ink on an accent fill; the vignette.

current.$description: The lit centre of the water; the watch's flat control disc.

surface.$description: The brightest water; an empty page's glyph.

foam.$description: Titles, a control's words, the user's own words.

text.$description: Running text a step below the words: snippets, summaries, the website's reading tone.

hint.$description: Placeholder and helper text inside an input: quieter than mist, but it clears 4.5:1 over a field on the glass card (faint measured about 2.2:1).

mist.$description: Meta lines, section labels, a tool's glyph, a quiet control's glyph.

faint.$description: The quietest ink: a chevron in content, an Example mark, a note under a field.

onAccent.$description: Ink on the accent fill (a Primary button's label, a badge's count).

onPhoto.$description: Ink laid on a photograph: a remove badge's ✕.

fill.$description: The one flat fill for tiles, fields and link cards. No border, no gradient.

raised.$description: A control in the content layer: a Secondary button, an attachment tile, a settings row's separator. A step brighter than a tile so it reads as a control.

pressedLift.$description: Added over a surface while it is pressed.

selected.$description: The part of a control that is on: the segmented switch's thumb, a chosen chip.

glassTint.$description: The faint tint a glass disc takes when it is ready or listening; never a solid light fill.

scrim.$description: The dim over a page while the capture overlay is up.

photoScrim.$description: A dark disc under a ✕ on a photograph, so it reads on any picture.

accent.$description: Soft near-white for interactive accents, kept monochrome: the tint, a Primary fill, the capture glyph, a Link button.

switchOn.$description: A switch's on state, #0770E8: a shade deeper and a touch more saturated than system blue, so on reads at a glance against the near-white knob.

glowWarm.$description: Whisper-warm white that sets the one lit thing apart by temperature rather than saturation: the Resurfacing label, the lamp, Beyond your Ocean.

shadow.$description: One soft drop shadow lifts a surface just above the water. The shadow belongs to the shape alone, so it stays cheap even under a picture.

tile.$description: Under a tile, a field, a link card.

control.$description: Under a raised control: tighter, since it sits closer to the page.

inset.$description: Under a thumb inside a control: the segmented switch's selected part.

bar.$description: Under a floating bar before iOS 26 (Liquid Glass draws its own).

text.$description: Behind words laid straight on the water, so they read over anything beneath.

motion.$description: Facet three: how things change. Motion is atmosphere, never information; every fact it implies is reachable through a tap, a label, or the Library. Five motions cover every state change; the lamp's slow choreography on Tide, the microphone's level bars and the sinking words of a caught whisper are art-directed and stay in their views.

touch.$description: A control answering a finger: a press, a glyph swap, a tint change on the disc.

quick.$description: A quick state change: a filter on or off, a bar showing or hiding, the Reduce Motion stand-in for anything slower.

standard.$description: The standard settle: layout, folding, a section opening, a scroll to the top.

lift.$description: Something floating in or out over the page: a toast, the capture overlay's phases, a reorder, a page turn.

gentle.$description: The gentle arrival of something new: a thought rising on Tide, a hint breathing in and out.
